about: Lamentations is a book of sad songs written after Jerusalem was destroyed. In the middle of the sadness there is hope.

pages.title: New Every Morning
pages.scene: The sun rising over a broken city
pages.text: Jerusalem was broken, and the people were very sad. They cried to God. But in the middle of the sad songs comes hope: "God's love never ends. His kindness is new every morning. Great is His faithfulness!"
pages.lesson: God's love is new every morning.
